fields.name: requested_knee_side
fields.description: Knee named on the request as the site of NHP-P-3005 (7.9). Taken from the request, not from notes.

fields.name: primary_diagnosis_code
fields.description: Primary ICD-10-CM code on the request.

fields.name: evidence_knee_side
fields.description: For each note or report used for 3.3, 3.4, 3.5, 4.1 or 4.2: the knee it describes, with document ID and quote.

fields.name: mechanical_symptom
fields.description: Each knee symptom description in a clinician note, classified against 7.3. 'word_only' = the note says locking or catching but no note describes what happens. Returns every dated mention.

fields.name: symptom_note_date
fields.description: Date of each clinician note that describes a knee symptom.

fields.name: xray_date
fields.description: Date each knee radiograph was taken.

fields.name: xray_weight_bearing
fields.description: Whether the report says the views were standing or weight-bearing (7.11).

fields.name: kl_grade_reported
fields.description: Kellgren-Lawrence grade the report gives, per compartment or overall, as written.

fields.name: joint_space_description
fields.description: Whether the report states complete loss of joint space or bone-on-bone contact in any compartment (7.6).

fields.name: kl_grade_highest
fields.description: Highest compartment grade per 7.6: the highest reported grade; if none, 4 when complete loss or bone-on-bone is stated; otherwise unknown (3.5 insufficient).

fields.name: xray_loose_body
fields.description: Whether the radiograph report describes a loose body, without a hedge (7.4).

fields.name: mri_date
fields.description: Date of each knee MRI scan.

fields.name: mri_lesion
fields.description: Lesion the MRI report describes, classified against 7.4. 'hedged' = described only as possible, probable, suspected or not excluded.

fields.name: exercise_therapy
fields.description: Structured exercise therapy for the requested knee (7.7(a)) with start and end dates. A home program counts only if a later visit documents it was followed.

fields.name: pharmacologic_measure
fields.description: Qualifying measure for 7.7(b), with dates. Acetaminophen counts only if an NSAID is documented as unsafe.

fields.name: conservative_care_start_date
fields.description: Start date of the first 7.7(a) or 7.7(b) measure.

fields.name: conservative_care_end_date
fields.description: End date of the last 7.7(a) or 7.7(b) measure; the request date when care is documented as ongoing.

fields.name: conservative_care_days
fields.description: Days from conservative_care_start_date to conservative_care_end_date (7.10: durations are day counts).

fields.name: locked_knee_exam
fields.description: Clinician exam finding against 7.8: cannot straighten fully, actively or passively, from a block, stated as new.

fields.name: locked_knee_exam_date
fields.description: Date of the exam that documents the locked knee.

fields.name: knee_replacement
fields.description: Any total or partial replacement of the requested knee, current or historical, anywhere in the chart.

fields.name: prior_arthroscopy_date
fields.description: Date of any prior arthroscopic procedure on the requested knee.

criteria.policy_text: The request names the requested knee as the right knee or the left knee.
criteria.summary: Request names the right or left knee
criteria.evidence: The request's knee field reads right or left. Blank, 'both' or 'unspecified' is insufficient evidence.

criteria.policy_text: No document included with the request places the diagnosis, the mechanical symptom or the imaging findings used to meet sections 3 and 4 in the knee opposite the requested knee.
criteria.summary: Diagnosis, symptom and imaging all refer to the requested knee
criteria.evidence: Every document used for 3.3 to 4.2, and the diagnosis code where it names a side, refers to the requested knee or to both knees. A bilateral code (M17.0, M17.2, M17.4) is consistent with either knee. A document naming no side is not a conflict.

flag_rules.when: Any document used for sections 3 or 4, or a sided diagnosis code, refers to the knee opposite the requested knee

criteria.policy_text: At least one mechanical symptom of the requested knee is documented in a clinician note dated within 3 months before the request date.
criteria.summary: A locking or catching symptom is documented in the last 3 months

flag_rules.when: The most recent symptom note in the window states there are no mechanical symptoms while an earlier note in the window describes one

children.policy_text: At least one mechanical symptom of the requested knee is documented
children.summary: Locking or catching described in terms that fit 7.3
children.evidence: A sentence in a clinician note describing locking (stuck, cannot straighten until manoeuvred or it releases) or catching (sudden brief block felt as catching). The bare word 'locks' or 'catches' with no description anywhere is insufficient evidence. Pain, stiffness, swelling, crepitus, clicking, giving way or pseudo-locking is not met.

children.policy_text: in a clinician note dated within 3 months before the request date
children.summary: That note is dated within 3 months

criteria.policy_text: A report of weight-bearing radiographs of the requested knee, taken within 12 months before the request date, is included with the request.
criteria.summary: Standing x-ray report of the requested knee from the last 12 months

children.policy_text: A report of weight-bearing radiographs of the requested knee
children.summary: Report says the views were standing or weight-bearing
children.evidence: A sentence in the radiograph report stating standing or weight-bearing views. A report that does not say is insufficient evidence; supine views are not met.

children.policy_text: taken within 12 months before the request date

criteria.policy_text: The most recent weight-bearing radiograph report that meets 3.4 grades the requested knee at no more than Kellgren–Lawrence grade 3, using the highest compartment grade (section 7.6).
criteria.summary: Highest compartment KL grade on the latest standing x-ray is 3 or lower

flag_rules.when: Two radiograph reports in the 3.4 window give the requested knee different KL grades on opposite sides of 3

criteria.summary: Conservative care was completed, or the knee is locked

children.policy_text: completion of adequate conservative care (section 7.7), with a mechanical symptom still documented after it ended
children.summary: 12+ weeks of exercise plus a drug or injection in the last 12 months, symptom persisting

children.policy_text: structured exercise therapy: supervised physical therapy, or a home exercise program prescribed by a clinician and documented as followed at a later visit
children.summary: Supervised PT or a home program confirmed at a later visit
children.evidence: PT notes, or a dated home exercise prescription plus a later note saying the member followed it.

children.policy_text: at least one of: an oral or topical anti-inflammatory drug (NSAID); acetaminophen, when an NSAID is documented as unsafe for the member; or an injection of corticosteroid into the requested knee
children.summary: NSAID, acetaminophen when NSAID unsafe, or knee steroid injection
children.evidence: A dated medication entry or injection note. Acetaminophen alone is met only with a documented reason an NSAID is unsafe.

children.policy_text: items (a) and (b) together spanned at least 12 weeks, from the start of the first measure to the end of the last
children.summary: Conservative care spanned at least 84 days

children.policy_text: the care ended, or was still ongoing, within 12 months before the request date
children.summary: Care ended or was ongoing within 12 months

children.policy_text: with a mechanical symptom still documented after it ended
children.evidence: A clinician note dated after conservative_care_end_date, or, when care is ongoing, at least 84 days after it started, that describes a symptom meeting 7.3.

children.policy_text: a locked knee (section 7.8), documented within 1 month before the request date
children.summary: Exam documents a newly locked knee in the last month

flag_rules.when: Notes call the knee locked but the exam also records a long-standing flexion contracture

children.policy_text: On a clinician's examination, the requested knee cannot be straightened fully, actively or passively, because of a block inside the joint, and the note states that the block is new for this member.
children.summary: Exam: new block to full straightening
children.evidence: An exam sentence that the knee cannot be fully straightened from a block, and a statement that it is new. Patient history of locking alone is not met here (it counts only for 3.3).

children.policy_text: documented within 1 month before the request date

criteria.summary: Imaging shows a lesion that can block the joint

flag_rules.when: The MRI or radiograph describes a qualifying lesion only with a hedge (possible, probable, suspected, cannot exclude)

children.policy_text: an MRI report of the requested knee, with the scan done within 6 months before the request date, that describes a mechanical lesion
children.summary: MRI in the last 6 months shows a mechanical lesion

children.policy_text: with the scan done within 6 months before the request date

children.summary: MRI describes a loose body, displaced or unstable meniscal tear, or unstable cartilage flap
children.evidence: A sentence in the MRI report describing a lesion listed in 7.4. A degenerative tear alongside a flap does not cancel the flap. Hedged findings are not met and raise 047-C7-F1.

children.policy_text: a weight-bearing radiograph report of the requested knee that meets 3.4 and describes a loose body (section 7.4(a))
children.summary: Standing x-ray from the 3.4 window shows a loose body
children.evidence: A sentence in a radiograph report that meets 3.4 describing a loose body without a hedge.

contraindications.policy_text: The requested knee has a total or partial knee replacement.
contraindications.summary: Requested knee has a knee replacement
contraindications.evidence: Any mention of a total, partial or unicompartmental replacement of the requested knee, including in past surgical history or imaging.

contraindications.policy_text: Active infection in the requested knee, or in the skin over it.
contraindications.summary: Active infection of the knee or overlying skin
contraindications.evidence: A current infection of the requested knee joint or the skin over it. A resolved infection is not found.

contraindications.policy_text: The treating surgeon or an anesthesia clinician states that elective knee surgery is currently unsafe for the member.
contraindications.summary: Surgeon or anesthesia says surgery is unsafe now
contraindications.evidence: An explicit statement that elective surgery is unsafe now. 'High risk' alone is not found; it goes in the case brief.

exclusions.policy_text: The planned procedure is washing out the joint (lavage) without removing any tissue.
exclusions.evidence: The request or operative plan describes washout or lavage with no debridement or removal of tissue.

exclusions.policy_text: An arthroscopic procedure was performed on the requested knee within 12 months before the request date.
exclusions.summary: Arthroscopy on the same knee in the last 12 months

exclusions.policy_text: The procedure is planned in the same operation as a knee replacement of the requested knee.
exclusions.summary: Planned with a knee replacement of the same knee
exclusions.evidence: The request or plan schedules debridement in the same operation as a replacement of the requested knee.

documentation.name: Prior authorization request
documentation.must_show: The requested knee (right or left), the primary ICD-10-CM diagnosis and the planned procedure

documentation.name: Treating clinician office note
documentation.must_show: Dated within 3 months; the member's own description of each knee symptom, the knee it affects, how often it happens, and an exam of the requested knee

documentation.name: Locked-knee examination note (only if 4.1(b) is used)
documentation.must_show: Dated within 1 month; inability to straighten the knee fully, that the block is new, and the knee examined

documentation.name: Weight-bearing radiograph report
documentation.must_show: Taken within 12 months; date, knee imaged, that the views were standing, KL grade or joint-space description for each compartment, and any loose body

documentation.name: MRI report (only if 4.2(a) is used)
documentation.must_show: Scan within 6 months; date, knee imaged, and the lesion found in the radiologist's words

documentation.name: Conservative care records (only if 4.1(a) is used)
documentation.must_show: PT notes or a dated home exercise prescription; medication list or notes with drug names and dates; injection notes; start and end dates of each measure

documentation.name: Surgical and medical history
documentation.must_show: Prior surgery on either knee with dates, and any current condition affecting surgical safety

ambiguities.issue: What "symptoms other than pain alone" covers
readings: Any non-pain symptom (stiffness, swelling, giving way)
ambiguities.recommended: Only a mechanical block; 7.3 is a closed list (D-015).

ambiguities.issue: Note says "knee locks up" with no description
ambiguities.recommended: Insufficient evidence, so request info for a symptom description (D-015).
ambiguities.encoded_as: mechanical_symptom value word_only maps to insufficient in 047-C3a.

ambiguities.recommended: Not a mechanical symptom unless a block is also described.

ambiguities.issue: Symptom reported by the member vs. seen on exam
ambiguities.recommended: History in a clinician note meets 3.3; only 4.1(b) needs an exam finding.

ambiguities.issue: "Still documented after it ended" when care is ongoing
ambiguities.recommended: Ongoing care counts once 84 days have passed and a later note documents the symptom.
ambiguities.encoded_as: Field conservative_care_end_date (request date when ongoing); 047-C6a.5 evidence text.

ambiguities.recommended: 84 days; durations are day counts, windows are calendar months (7.10, D-019).

ambiguities.issue: No KL grade, report says "severe narrowing"
ambiguities.recommended: Not shown, so insufficient. Only complete loss or bone-on-bone maps to grade 4.

ambiguities.issue: Two reports in the window disagree on grade
ambiguities.recommended: Most recent, and flag the conflict.

ambiguities.issue: MRI hedges ("cannot exclude a displaced fragment")
ambiguities.recommended: Not shown; mark insufficient and flag for clinician review.

ambiguities.issue: MRI shows a degenerative tear and a flap component

readings: In scope, side from the request
ambiguities.recommended: In scope; a missing side is a request-info gap under 3.1.

ambiguities.issue: Bilateral diagnosis code on a one-knee request
Clinician calls surgery "high risk" but proceeds
ambiguities.recommended: Not found unless the note says surgery is unsafe now; 'high risk' goes in the brief.
